verdict.rationale: Customer.io has a dedicated transactional path: a separate transactional API via the App API, aimed at receipts, password resets and shipping updates, with per-call data to populate the message (docs-14, 23, 25, 52). That shows transactional is a distinct send type from broadcasts and automations, but the pack does not show the isolation the story depends on. missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends bypass unsubscribe/suppression so receipts reach unsubscribed contacts, separate sending reputation (IP/domain pools) for transactional vs marketing, documentation of distinct transactional templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
